description: Header file defining the SwapChain11 class for managing a Direct3D 11 swap chain in the ANGLE project, including methods for resizing, resetting, swapping buffers, and accessing render targets and textures.

classes.name: SwapChain11
classes.description: A class representing a Direct3D 11 swap chain, managing buffers, textures, and rendering targets for the ANGLE graphics layer.

methods.name: SwapChain11
methods.description: Constructor initializing the swap chain with renderer, window, textures, and format parameters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the swap chain with new dimensions and swap interval.

methods.name: swapRect
methods.description: Performs buffer swap within specified rectangle.

methods.name: getRenderTargetShaderResource
methods.description: Returns the shader resource view for the render target.

methods.name: getDepthStencilShaderResource
methods.description: Returns the shader resource view for the depth stencil.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the swap chain.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the swap chain.

methods.name: getKeyedMutex
methods.description: Returns the keyed mutex for synchronization.

methods.name: getSamples
methods.description: Returns the number of samples used.

methods.name: getSwapChainNativeFormat
methods.description: Returns the native DXGI format of the swap chain.
